annotations.title: Fee tables (dated, sourced): Etsy, Shopify, Amazon

description: Returns one platform's fee table, the one this server's numbers use: every fee and rule with its value, a plain label, its source link and the day it was checked, whether it's official or a third-party estimate, and both values where sources disagree, plus when the table is due for its next check. Etsy: listing, transaction, processing, Offsite Ads, Etsy Ads minimums, shipping lines, Etsy Plus, tax facts. Shopify: plan prices on both billings, card rates, the third-party processor fee, currency, chargebacks, Shopify Tax. Amazon: plans, referral by category and the media closing fee (official), and FBA, storage, returns, peak and coupon fees (third-party estimates: Amazon's own tables sit behind the Seller Central login). It serves to cite a platform's fees, to answer what a fee is, or to check how current the numbers are. Takes no figures; platform defaults to etsy. Free, no sign-in. Nothing is stored.
name: sellerprofit_rates

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which rates are third-party estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest sit behind the Seller Central login). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.

conflict.description: When sources disagree: every value with its source; the higher cost is the one used.

exactness.description: official: the platform's own public page. third-party-estimate: a third-party rate card; every figure built on it is an estimate.

value.description: A number for one rule: cents for money, a fraction for a rate (0.065 is 6.5%), else a count of months, days or items. A table (referral by category, the FBA card) is an object or list in the same units.

verified.description: False when no primary source confirmed the figure.
